title_zh: 安排慈善机构理事交接说明

scenario.label_zh: 安排慈善机构理事交接说明
scenario.goal_zh: 说明理事任期与记录背景并约定交接记录并补上人员变动说明

context_zh: 虚构慈善机构内部交接练习。Helen 即将结束理事任期，Mo 将接手她保管的会议记录。
author: author-phase12-c

sentences.speaker: Helen
sentences.text: My tenure as a trustee ends next month, so we should go through the records before then.

sentences.speaker: Mo
sentences.text: Have you kept them throughout your time on the board?

sentences.speaker: Helen
sentences.text: Not quite. I helped with events in my first year; thereafter, I took responsibility for the meeting notes.

sentences.speaker: Mo
sentences.text: With all the staff turnover last winter, a few names in those notes are unfamiliar to me.

sentences.speaker: Helen
sentences.text: I'll add a short list of who held each role, then we can go through the decisions together.

sentences.speaker: Mo
sentences.text: That would be useful. Let's do the handover before the next board meeting.
